title: Fifth light · v0.5, clues from entities
note: Same cast and models on v0.5: entities that are moved give up a clue. Players searched as rarely as before (3 of 12 actions), but the Gardener, the Prime and the Pattern each let one slip, so the party reached the finale with 8 clues against fourth light's 0. The first theory missed; the second proved great. Weak spot: Ingression filled as the finale opened, so the ending is overrun, not chosen.

title: Fourth light · v0.4, the deck
